  1988	17.1 Overview
  1989	The Twilight Council works to suppress violence by
  1990	bringing together the Woodfolk in assemblies, hop­
  1991	ing to draw the civil war to an end. Assemblies let the
  1992	Council score victory points, banish enemy warriors
  1993	from their clearings, and gain loyalists, warriors on
  1994	their player board that they can later place at assem­
  1995	blies. The Council acts as peacekeepers at their assem­
  1996	blies, defending enemy factions when they’re attacked.
  1997	By ruling assemblies, the Council can flip assemblies
  1998	to their governing side. In Evening, they score points
  1999	based on the number of Governing assemblies with any
  2000	enemy buildings or tokens at them. Their governors
  2001	limit the actions that enemies can take at Governing as­
  2002	semblies, unless those enemies entreat the Council to
  2003	close the assembly for a time.
